thread:
mike: Heads-up — planning tenant-metadata backfill during tonight's change window 00:30-01:30 UTC. This needs an index add + backfill. Deploybot currently scheduled at 00:35. Any blockers? I'll pin the release if we're good.

sophie: Can we snooze Deploybot by 30m? Backfill could run longer than expected and I want to avoid a mid-backfill redeploy. :thinking_face:

javier: Agree with snooze. Also we should run the backfill in 'icebox' mode for low traffic shards first (stagger tenants). If any row-locking shows up we abort.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job: tenant-metadata-backfill v2.14.3 -> scheduled 00:35 UTC. To snooze run `deploy-bot snooze 00:30`.

mike: OK doing a staged rollout: canary (shards 1-5) at 00:40, pause 10m, then stagger waves. I'll pin to v2.14.3 and put a hard holdpoint at +20m after canary.

sophie: Add a feature-flag to opt out for heavy tenants — saves rollback pain. Rollback plan: disable flag -> quick DB index drop not needed, we rely on app-side toggle. Snippet for release notes: `flag: tenant_meta_backfill_opt_out`

javier: Monitoring checklist: slow queries dashboard, pg_locks heatmap, deploybot hook for automatic abort if >2000 blocked row locks. infra-oncall, can you set a watch?

infra-oncall: On it. I'll wire an alert that fires if lock_waits/sec > 5 or avg_query_time spikes > 2s during the backfill window. Also will leave a manual escape hatch: `kubectl rollout pause deploy/worker-backfill` if we see cascading stalls.

mike: I'll update release notes and pin the version. Also adding an explicit rollback step in the PR description: `if backfill causes >1% error rate rollback to v2.14.2 and abort backfill`

sophie: :thumbsup: Please include the exact shard list and expected runtime per shard in the notes. Helps SRE decide thresholds.

mike: Will add shard ETA table to the PR. Running preflight at 00:20 to validate index ddl on canary DB replica.

deploy-bot: Ack — snooze applied. New deploy time 01:05 UTC. Canary window set. Holdpoints: canary_end +20m.

javier: Thanks. I'll be on-call for the backfill and will post mid-run updates in this thread.

mike: Great — proceeding. If anything changes I'll ping here and @infra-oncall.

sophie: LGTM.

infra-oncall: Watch created, alerting configured. Good luck.
